instruction: Please help me change the display language of VS Code to "Chinese (Simplified)" without using any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because changing VS Code's display language to Chinese (Simplified) requires installing language pack extensions or system-level language support that is not available in the test environment. VS Code language packs are distributed as extensions and cannot be installed without using the extension system.
